frozen_at.note: origin/main when the hashes below were taken. The hashes, not the commit, are what the test checks; a change to a listed file after this record merges is a decision, not a side effect of a pull request.

window.note: The judge's confirmation window (metadata/pressure_judge.json). Its near-blind days were opened once for the final test (#151, 2026-10-05) and are ordinary history in metadata/lockbox.json; the judge's confirmation.candidates is the gate.

panel.note: The published panel rebuilt from the tracked fixtures (REPRODUCIBILITY.md); verify-panel is clean. The scratch panels the candidates are scored on are built from it by the scripts named per candidate.

judge.primary_test: The pressure-day judge as in force at frozen_at.commit: a pressure day is SOFR - IORB > +5 bp (strictly, on whole basis points); tier 1 (onset warning) is the primary test.
judge.pass_rule: As in src/repo_model/pressure_judge.py and docs/decisions/judge-rulings-10-october.md: tier 1 at lead >= 1, tier 3 at every lead, and tier 5, under the weighted miss rule in force (docs/decisions/weighted-miss.md). Recall and false alarms inside and outside 2018-19, the per-lead readings and the equal-weight-per-regime recall are reported, not tiers. The confirmation look scores 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-03 and nothing else (pressure_judge.require_scored_days).

benchmarks.how: Each candidate is scored by the judge's own benchmarks, produced the way every candidate is (pressure_judge.benchmark_forecasts, scripts/pressure_judge.py forecasts), paired on the same days, with the judge's stationary-bootstrap interval (metadata/pressure_judge.json, bootstrap), split by regime, scarcity state and pressure-day type (the judge's groupings). A pooled figure alone is not a result.

comparison.primary_contrast: For each candidate, the judge's tier 1 recall condition: recall of onsets warned at lead >= 1 against calendar_climatology at the same false-alarm rate, paired, with the bootstrap interval.
comparison.correction: Bonferroni across the three: a candidate is said to beat a benchmark only if the paired interval at level 1 - 0.10/3 (about 96.7%) excludes zero, in place of the judge's 90%. The 90% intervals are reported beside them. The pass rule itself is read as in force, unadjusted, and is reported for all three.
comparison.among_the_three: The three are compared with one another only through the same paired differences, each with the corrected interval; no winner is declared from a pooled figure. The selection is the three; no fourth candidate is added after the window is read.
comparison.status: A proposal drafted for Eleonora: the multiplicity correction is a judgement call and is hers (docs/decisions/confirmation-preregistration.md, 'For Eleonora').

opening.how: Naming the three candidates in confirmation.candidates of metadata/pressure_judge.json (the pull request carries Eleonora's own attestation, metadata/owner_attestations.json, #256). repo_model.confirmation.require_confirmation_open refuses a window day for a candidate until then, and for every candidate if a hashed file no longer matches.
